prompt.text:
Implement a complete TypeScript source file for deterministic pass issuance. Export `PassKind`, `PassRecord`, `PassInput`, `AuditSink`, `PassRegistry`, `createObserverPass`, `createBuilderPass`, and `createHostPass`.

Each creation function accepts `(registry: PassRegistry, input: PassInput, sink: AuditSink)` and creates its respective kind. Trim `handle`; reject an empty handle with `TypeError`. Handles are unique case-insensitively across all kinds; duplicates throw `Error`. Use the supplied secret after trimming, or the default `welcome-2026` when missing or blank. IDs are sequential per kind: `O-0001`, `B-0001`, and `H-0001`, padded to at least four digits.

Before changing registry state, call `sink.publish` with `pass-created:<id>:<normalized-handle>`, where the normalized handle is lowercase. If publishing throws, the registry—including its sequence counter—must remain unchanged. On success, store and return a fresh `PassRecord`. `get(id)` and `list()` must also return fresh records; `list()` preserves successful creation order. Inputs, returned records, and sink objects must never be stored by reference.

`PassRegistry` is initially empty. State-changing mechanics may be public only as needed by the three exported creation functions, but callers must not be able to inject malformed records.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
